fields.description: Stable identifier the till sends back on record_cashier_expense. Never shown to the operator, so it must not be renamed once cashiers have used it - the label fields exist to be changed instead.
fields.label: Key

fields.description: Arabic label shown at the till. The chart of accounts cannot carry this, which is the reason these categories are configured here rather than derived from it.
fields.label: Label (Arabic)

fields.description: The expense account debited when a cashier books this category. Must be a ledger account with root type Expense; the endpoint refuses any other, because a category pointing at a non-expense account books the till payout somewhere no expense report will find it.
fields.label: Expense Account

fields.description: Disabled categories stay on record so historic vouchers keep resolving, but are not offered at the till.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Leave blank to offer this category for every company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The clinic this expense is attributed to, stamped onto the voucher. Boarding revenue is already attributed through the `hotel` branch (Pet Boarding Settings.boarding_branch), so using Branch here keeps both sides of the P&L on one dimension. Leave blank for a category that belongs to no single clinic - those are offered whatever branch the caller asks for.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Optional. Set on the voucher's journal lines when present, which is the only dimension of the two that reaches GL Entry and so ERPNext's own P&L filters.
fields.label: Cost Center
